envelope.claim: specification-derived operating approximation, not a PCTL guarantee
envelope.trial: violation at one (node, start) drawn uniformly with a seed derived from the replicate seed

pilot.status: dispersion only; no pilot cell is reused

test.decision: reject at the first replicate whose e-value reaches 240
test.pairing: arms share the replicate seed; differences are within the replicate
test.plug_ins: past differences only; prior mean 0, prior variance 1, weight one observation
test.scale_rationale: beta lies in [0, 1], so paired differences lie in [-1, 1]
test.two_sided: average of the bets on d and on -d

exclusion_criteria: runs whose decision log fails hash-chain verification
runs whose conformal detector reports saturation
runs that aborted before completing their declared horizon

hypotheses.question: With the fixed policy, does the projection shield attain a higher fill rate than the inadmissible null fallback (F-null)?
hypotheses.rationale: The central effect of v1, re-measured on the corrected engine. F-null replaces an inadmissible order by zero even when zero is itself inadmissible, so it can hold the chain in the unsafe region.

hypotheses.question: Does H1 hold with the Q-learning policy?
hypotheses.rationale: The same comparison with a learned policy in place of the fixed one.

hypotheses.question: Does the projection shield differ in fill rate from the admissible backup fallback (F-backup)?
hypotheses.rationale: Separates minimal correction from admissibility. Two-sided because either result decides the scenario: no difference means admissibility is what matters; a difference says which operator adds value.

hypotheses.question: Does mediation without a shield change the fill rate relative to no supervision, over the same horizon?
hypotheses.rationale: RQ4 of v1, which compared 60 governed periods with 40 ungoverned ones. Both arms now run 60 periods. Two-sided: with the horizon corrected there is no defensible directional prediction.

hypotheses.question: Does H1 replicate on the five-echelon chain?
hypotheses.rationale: Topology invariance of the central effect.

hypotheses.question: Does H1 hold once the start-up periods are excluded?
hypotheses.rationale: Beta over periods 27 to 59 only, after the detector's burn-in (12) and warm-up (15). Rules out an effect produced only by the start-up transient.

plan.notes: Arms share seeds by replicate, so every comparison is paired on the same demand path and disruption schedule, and each replicate carries its own seed, so the paired differences are i.i.d. across replicates.
